name: browser/dismiss
description: Clear the cookie banners and modals that swallow the first click on most sites. Every step is optional - none of them are reliably there.

steps.note: A promo modal. area:content is LOAD-BEARING here - without it this matched Chrome's own window-close button at (2834,40) and the tab-close at (514,40), either of which would have ended the run by closing the browser. It only got away with it because two matches made it ambiguous.
